The final answer, β = 1/α, is correct.

Sibson's α-mutual information for a discrete input over a Gaussian channel is
$$I_\alpha(X;Y)=\frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}\log\int\Big(\sum_i p_i\,\varphi(y-\sqrt{\mathsf{snr}}\,x_i)^\alpha\Big)^{1/\alpha}dy.$$

As snr → ∞, the Gaussian bumps centered at the points √snr·xᵢ separate. Near each bump only one term dominates, so
$$\Big(\sum_i p_i\varphi_i^\alpha\Big)^{1/\alpha}\approx\sum_i p_i^{1/\alpha}\varphi_i.$$
Each φᵢ integrates to 1, so the integral tends to Σᵢ pᵢ^{1/α}.

The limit is therefore
$$\frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}\log\sum_i p_i^{1/\alpha}.$$

The Rényi entropy of order β is H_β = (1/(1−β)) log Σ pᵢ^β. With β = 1/α, the prefactor is 1/(1−1/α) = α/(α−1). This matches the limit exactly.

The proposed derivation takes a roundabout route through rescaled Gaussian densities with constants c_α. The constants do cancel to 1, and the result agrees with the direct computation above. The final answer is correct.
